fields.climate: tropical marine; humid; cooler season during southeast monsoon (late May to September); warmer season during northwest monsoon (March to May)
fields.terrain: Mahe Group is volcanic with a narrow coastal strip and rocky, hilly interior; others are relatively flat coral atolls, or elevated reefs; sits atop the submarine Mascarene Plateau
fields.hazards: lies outside the cyclone belt, so severe storms are rare; occasional short droughts
fields.farm: coconuts, vegetables, bananas, eggs, chicken, pork, fruits, tomatoes, tropical fruits, cassava
fields.exports: fish, scrap iron, animal meal, broadcasting equipment, ships
fields.languages: Seychellois Creole (official) 89.1%, English (official) 5.1%, French (official) 0.7%, other 3.8%, unspecified 1.4%
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 76.2%, Protestant 10.5% (Anglican 6.1%, Pentecostal Assembly 1.5%, Seventh Day Adventist 1.2%, other Protestant 1.7%), other Christian 2.4%, Hindu 2.4%, Muslim 1.6%, other…
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law, French civil law, and customary law
fields.military: 18-35 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
